unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፫ — Meraf 3: Advanced Mastery of በ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You have mastered the advanced levels of በ!
success_screen.headline_am: ድንቅ ነው! የላቀውን የበ ቤተሰብ ደረጃን በጥሩ ሁኔታ አጠናቀቁ!

games.title: Word Assembly: ቤት
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters to build the word for House / Home!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select the fifth form 'ቤ' first, then end with 'ት'!

games.title: Word Finish: ቡና
games.instructions_en: Look at the incomplete word for 'Coffee': ቡ[ ? ]. Select the correct missing Amharic letter!

games.title: Audio Blend: ቢ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the sound blend. Which symbol represents the exact 'Bi' sound you hear?
games.target_phonetic_description: The 3rd form ('I' vowel sound): 'Bi' as in 'Birabiro'

games.title: Word Assembly: ባቡር
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with fourth form 'ባ', then second form 'ቡ', and finish with sixth form 'ር'!

games.title: Word Finish: ብርቱካን
games.instructions_en: Find the missing letter to complete the word for orange fruit: ብ[ ? ]ቱካን.
games.tips_en: The full word is ብርቱካን (pronounced Bir-tu-kan).

games.title: Audio Blend: ቦ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely. Which symbol represents the 7th form 'Bo' sound with the small ring added to the top-right corner?

games.title: Word Assembly: ቦርሳ
games.tips_en: Tip: Start with seventh form 'ቦ', middle sixth form 'ር', and end with 'ሳ'!

games.title: Word Finish: ደብተር
games.instructions_en: Complete the word for 'Notebook / Exercise book': ደ[ ? ]ተር.
games.tips_en: The full word is ደብተር (pronounced Deb-ter).
